label: Do Action Component
description: Renders a ThunderPHP do_action() call that can be inserted into HTML components with a normal TVI component marker.

properties.name: hook_name
properties.label: Hook name
properties.help: Select an existing action hook or type a custom hook name. Custom names from these nodes are added to the Controller Hook and View dropdowns.

properties.name: argument_name
properties.label: Data variable
properties.help: Variable passed to do_action(). Enter data or $data. If it is unavailable at runtime, an empty array is passed.

properties.name: component_name
properties.label: Component name
properties.help: Use this name in the HTML Component Designer with <tvi-component name="..." />.
